description: This file defines the AliasController class implementing IAliasController interface, managing entity aliases, filters, and datasource resolution in a Thingsboard UI context.

classes.name: AliasController
classes.description: Manages entity aliases, filters, and datasource resolution for Thingsboard UI.

methods.name: updateEntityAliases
methods.description: Updates entity aliases and triggers change notifications for altered aliases.

methods.name: updateFilters
methods.description: Updates filters and triggers change notifications for altered filters.

methods.name: updateAliases
methods.description: Refreshes alias information by resolving aliases and notifying changes.

methods.name: dashboardStateChanged
methods.description: Detects changes in dashboard state and updates alias resolutions accordingly.

methods.name: setAliasUnresolved
methods.description: Clears cached alias and device info for a given alias ID.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns current entity aliases.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns current filters.

methods.name: getUserFilters
methods.description: Returns current user filters.

methods.name: getFilterInfo
methods.description: Retrieves filter info by filter ID, prioritizing user filters.

methods.name: getKeyFilters
methods.description: Converts filter info to key filters.

methods.name: getEntityAliasId
methods.description: Finds alias ID by alias name.

methods.name: getAliasInfo
methods.description: Resolves alias info asynchronously, with caching.

methods.name: resolveSingleEntityInfo
methods.description: Resolves entity info for a given alias ID.

methods.name: resolveSingleEntityInfoForDeviceId
methods.description: Resolves entity info for a device ID.

methods.name: resolveSingleEntityInfoForTargetDevice
methods.description: Resolves entity info for a target device.

methods.name: resolveDatasource
methods.description: Resolves and enriches a datasource, resolving aliases and filters.

methods.name: resolveAlarmSource
methods.description: Resolves a datasource for alarm source, adjusting name fields.

methods.name: resolveDatasources
methods.description: Resolves multiple datasources, optionally for a single entity.

methods.name: getInstantAliasInfo
methods.description: Returns cached alias info immediately.

methods.name: updateCurrentAliasEntity
methods.description: Updates current entity info for an alias and triggers change notification.

methods.name: updateUserFilter
methods.description: Updates user filters and triggers change notification.
